name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
short_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme funded 100% by the Government of India. Under the scheme, income support of ₹6,000/- per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000/- each is provided to all landholding farmer families.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: ₹6,000 / year direct bank transfer (DBT)
documents: Active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
application_steps: Fill land and bank details and submit
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / myScheme

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
short_description: Health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families.
full_description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health insurance/assurance scheme fully financed by the government. It provides a cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and private empanelled hospitals in India.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: ₹5,000,000 cashless health insurance cover per family / year
target_beneficiaries: Poor and vulnerable families identified under SECC 2011
documents: Ration Card or SECC Household Verification
application_steps: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest Ayushman Kendra

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh (Plains) to ₹1.30 Lakh (Hilly/Difficult areas) for construction of pucca house for rural homeless.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefit: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 housing subsidy + 90 days MGNREGA labor wage
target_beneficiaries: Rural homeless households & kutcha house dwellers
application_steps: Gram Sabha identifies eligible households based on SECC 2011 data
Block Development Officer registers application on AwaasSoft portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
short_description: Housing financial assistance and interest subsidy up to ₹2.50 Lakh for EWS/LIG/MIG families in urban areas.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 provides central assistance to construct, purchase, or rent pucca houses for 1 crore urban poor and middle-class families.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Interest subsidy & financial grant up to ₹2,50,000 per house
target_beneficiaries: Urban EWS, LIG, and MIG families without a pucca house
application_steps: Select Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) or Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
short_description: Financial assistance including maintenance allowance and non-refundable fees for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation studies.
full_description: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + annual maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500
source_name: National Scholarship Portal / Ministry of Social Justice

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
short_description: Financial assistance including tuition fees and maintenance grant for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education.
full_description: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage in recognized institutions.
benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement + Monthly maintenance allowance

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
short_description: Financial aid for Other Backward Class students studying at post-matriculation stage.
full_description: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students is intended to provide financial assistance to OBC students studying at post-secondary stage to complete their education.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Course fee allowance + Monthly maintenance grant

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
short_description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60 for unorganized sector workers.
full_description: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme in India targeted at the unorganized sector. Under the APY, guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000/-, ₹2,000/-, ₹3,000/-, ₹4,000/- or ₹5,000/- per month will be given at the age of 60 years depending on the contributions made.
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
benefit: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 40 years
documents: Active Savings Bank Account with auto-debit facility
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or net banking portal

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
short_description: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakh for non-farm micro and small enterprises under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Loans are given under three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh).
benefit: Collateral-free institutional loan up to ₹10,00,000
target_beneficiaries: Micro entrepreneurs, shopkeepers, artisans, small business owners
application_steps: Upload business plan and bank statement

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
short_description: End-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople including PM Vishwakarma Certificate, ID Card, skill training, toolkits, and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 Lakh.
full_description: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme to provide holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades. Beneficiaries receive ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and loans at concessional 5% interest rate.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit stipend + Collateral-free loan up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% interest
target_beneficiaries: Artisans & Craftsmen in 18 traditional trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Tailors, etc.)
application_steps: Visit Common Services Centre (CSC) or pmvishwakarma.gov.in

name: PM SVANidhi (Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
short_description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors providing working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with interest subsidy of 7% per annum.
full_description: PM SVANidhi is a Special Micro-Credit Facility for Street Vendors to facilitate working capital loans up to ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment and cashback on digital transactions.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Working capital loan up to ₹50,000 + 7% interest subsidy + digital cashback
documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by ULB
application_steps: Apply online or visit local bank branch
source_name: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / myScheme

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
short_description: Free LPG gas connection along with first refill and stove to adult women from poor households.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 provides deposit-free LPG connection to adult women from economically weaker households across India, including migrant households who can submit self-declaration for address proof.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit: Free LPG Connection + First Refill + Stove (Hotplate)
target_beneficiaries: Adult women from BPL / SC / ST / EBC households
application_steps: Visit pmuy.gov.in or nearest LPG distributor (Indane/Bharatgas/HP)
Submit Ujjwala application form with Aadhaar e-KYC
Distributor inspects and installs free LPG connection
source_name: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas / myScheme

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
short_description: Government small savings scheme for girl child offering high interest rate (8.2%) and tax deduction under Section 80C.
full_description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a small deposit scheme for the girl child launched under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign. An account can be opened in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age with a minimum deposit of ₹250 per year.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Department of Posts & Ministry of Finance
benefit: 8.2% p.a. guaranteed interest rate + Tax exemption under 80C
target_beneficiaries: Girl children up to 10 years of age
application_steps: Visit nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
short_description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises.
full_description: Stand-Up India Scheme facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.
benefit: Bank loan between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 for greenfield business
target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age
application_steps: Apply online via Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in)
Fill registration form and select Handholding agency / Bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
short_description: Accidental insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh cover for accidental death or full disability at a premium of just ₹20 per year.
full_description: PMSBY is an affordable accident insurance scheme available to people in the age group 18 to 70 years with a bank account who give consent to join / enable auto-debit on an annual basis.
benefit: ₹200,000 accidental death/total disability cover for ₹20/year
target_beneficiaries: Bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years
documents: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit Consent
application_steps: Submit PMSBY consent form to your bank or enable via mobile banking
Annual premium of ₹20 auto-debited in May
source_name: Jan Suraksha Portal / Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
short_description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh life cover for death due to any reason at an annual premium of ₹436.
full_description: PMJJBY is a one-year renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh coverage for death due to any reason to bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years.
benefit: ₹200,000 life insurance cover for ₹436/year
target_beneficiaries: Bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years
documents: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit Consent
application_steps: Submit PMJJBY form at bank branch or apply through net banking
source_name: Jan Suraksha Portal / Ministry of Finance

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
short_description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion providing zero-balance bank accounts, RuPay debit card, ₹2 Lakh free accident insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana ensures access to financial services, namely basic savings bank accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.
benefit: Zero balance savings account + RuPay debit card + ₹2 Lakh accident insurance + ₹10,000 overdraft
target_beneficiaries: Unbanked citizens across urban and rural India
documents: Aadhaar Card or Voter ID / Driving License / NREGA Job Card
application_steps: Visit any commercial bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk
Submit e-KYC and collect RuPay card

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
short_description: Maternity financial benefit of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second living child.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana is a direct benefit transfer scheme under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) providing cash incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage loss and nutritional support.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit: ₹5,000 for first child + ₹6,000 for second girl child
application_steps: Register at Anganwadi Centre or apply online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
short_description: Free industry-relevant skill training, certification, and placement assistance for unemployed youth.
full_description: PMKVY 4.0 is the flagship skill certification scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) implemented by NSDC to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefit: Free Skill Training + Government Certificate + Stipend & Job Placement Support
target_beneficiaries: Indian youth looking for skill training and employment
application_steps: Register on Skill India Digital portal (skillindiadigital.gov.in)
Enroll in preferred job role course

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
short_description: Conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 in six installments to girl children in Uttar Pradesh from birth up to higher education.
full_description: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana is a flagship State Government scheme of Uttar Pradesh to ensure financial assistance to girls for health and education in 6 stages from birth to graduation/diploma.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, UP
benefit: ₹25,000 total financial incentive across 6 education milestones
target_beneficiaries: Girl children of Uttar Pradesh residents with annual family income up to ₹3 Lakh
application_steps: Click on Citizen Service Portal Registration
Fill online application and upload certificates

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana 2.0 (Madhya Pradesh)
short_description: Financial assurance and education incentives totaling over ₹1,43,000 for girl children in Madhya Pradesh.
full_description: Ladli Laxmi Yojana 2.0 is a comprehensive state welfare scheme of Madhya Pradesh to lay firm foundations for girl children by providing financial assistance at birth, school admission, and ₹25,000 college entrance grant.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, MP
benefit: Assurance bond + ₹25,000 college grant (Total benefit over ₹1.43 Lakh)
target_beneficiaries: Girl children born in MP to non-taxpayer parents
application_steps: Apply via Anganwadi worker or online at ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in
Upload Samagra ID and Birth Certificate

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 to the female head of every eligible household in Karnataka.
full_description: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme is one of the five guarantee schemes of the Karnataka State Government, providing direct benefit transfer of ₹2,000 per month to women who are designated as heads of households in Ration Cards (BPL / APL).
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka
benefit: ₹2,000 / month direct bank transfer
target_beneficiaries: Women household heads in Karnataka holding Ration Cards
application_steps: Visit Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) or Karnataka One centre

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
short_description: Monthly rights grant of ₹1,000 to eligible women heads of households across Tamil Nadu.
full_description: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme is a flagship social welfare programme of Tamil Nadu Government providing a monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 to adult women heads of eligible families.
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Tamil Nadu
benefit: ₹1,000 / month direct cash transfer
target_beneficiaries: Women heads of families in TN with annual family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
application_steps: Camp held at local Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop)
Submit token form with biometric Aadhaar verification

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
short_description: Annual financial assistance of ₹13,500 per farmer family in Andhra Pradesh for agricultural operational costs.
full_description: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM Kisan is a State Government scheme of Andhra Pradesh providing financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year to farmer families including tenant farmers belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority categories.
benefit: ₹13,500 / year per farmer family
target_beneficiaries: Landowning and tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh
documents: CCORC (Crop Cultivator Rights Certificate for Tenants)
application_steps: Verify name in Village Secretariat (Rythu Bharosa Kendra)
Submit land pattadar and bank details
Field verification by Agricultural Extension Officer

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
short_description: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) to unmarried girl students in West Bengal to prevent child marriage.
full_description: Kanyashree Prakalpa is an award-winning conditional cash transfer scheme aimed at improving the status and wellbeing of the girl child in West Bengal by incentivizing school education and delaying marriage until age 18.
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal
benefit: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 + One-time grant of ₹25,000 at age 18
target_beneficiaries: Unmarried girls aged 13-19 enrolled in school/college in West Bengal
application_steps: Collect Kanyashree application form from school / college Headmaster
Headmaster uploads form on wbkanyashree.gov.in portal

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana (Rajasthan)
short_description: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year for all residents of Rajasthan.
full_description: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana provides universal health coverage up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year for inpatient medical treatment across government and empanelled private hospitals in Rajasthan.
ministry: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department, Rajasthan
benefit: Cashless health insurance up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year
target_beneficiaries: All families holding Jan Aadhar card in Rajasthan
application_steps: Free registration for NFSA / SECC / Small Farmers; nominal premium for others

name: Delhi Free Bus Travel Scheme for Women (Pink Pass)
short_description: 100% free bus travel in DTC and DIMTS AC & Non-AC buses for all female commuters in Delhi.
full_description: The Government of NCT of Delhi provides zero-ticket (Pink Pass) free bus travel for all female passengers travelling on Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) and Cluster (DIMTS) buses across the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
ministry: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
benefit: 100% Free Bus Travel in all DTC and DIMTS buses in Delhi
target_beneficiaries: All women and girl commuters travelling in Delhi
documents: None required onboard (Conductor issues Pink Pass ticket)
application_steps: Board any DTC or DIMTS bus in Delhi
Ask bus conductor for Pink Pass
No fee or ID verification required
source_name: Government of NCT of Delhi / DTC

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
short_description: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,500 to women aged 21-65 years in Maharashtra.
full_description: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is a major social assistance scheme launched by the Government of Maharashtra to provide direct monthly financial support of ₹1,500 to adult married, widowed, divorced, or single women.
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra
benefit: ₹1,500 / month direct benefit transfer
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 21 to 65 years residing in Maharashtra with annual income under ₹2.5 Lakh
application_steps: Apply via 'Nari Shakti Doot' mobile application or Anganwadi center

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
short_description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens aged 60 years and above under the National Social Assistance Programme.
full_description: IGNOAPS is a core Centrally Sponsored Scheme under NSAP providing monthly social security pension to elderly citizens living below the poverty line (BPL).
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹400 to ₹1,000 (Central + State contribution)
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to BPL households
application_steps: Submit application at Block Development Office (BDO) / Gram Panchayat / Tehsildar office
Physical verification by Social Welfare Inspector
source_name: Ministry of Rural Development / NSAP Portal

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
short_description: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks at nominal premium rates for farmers.
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of natural calamities, pests & diseases to stabilize their income.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Comprehensive crop loss compensation calculated per hectare
target_beneficiaries: Loanee and non-loanee farmers growing notified crops
application_steps: Apply via pmfby.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre / Bank Branch
Claim automatically settled on crop loss notification

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
short_description: Free food grains (5kg wheat/rice per person per month) to over 80 crore beneficiaries under NFSA.
full_description: PMGKAY provides 5 kg of free food grains per month to all beneficiaries covered under Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) cards.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
department: Department of Food and Public Distribution
benefit: 5 kg free foodgrains per person per month
target_beneficiaries: NFSA Ration Card holders (AAY & PHH families)
application_steps: Visit local Fair Price Shop (PDS FPS)
source_name: Department of Food and Public Distribution

name: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
short_description: Financial voucher assistance of ₹50,000 over 5 years (₹10,000 per year) to over 1 crore women in Odisha.
full_description: Subhadra Yojana is a flagship women empowerment scheme launched by the Government of Odisha providing ₹10,000 annually in two installments of ₹5,000 each on Raksha Bandhan and International Women's Day.
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Odisha
benefit: ₹50,000 direct benefit over 5 years (₹10,000/year)
target_beneficiaries: Women aged 21 to 60 years residing in Odisha
documents: National Food Security Act (NFSA) / State Food Security Scheme Card
application_steps: Collect physical form free of cost at Mo Seba Kendra / Anganwadi
Submit completed form at designated counters

name: Abua Awas Yojana (Jharkhand)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹2 Lakh in 4 installments for construction of 3-room housing for poor families in Jharkhand.
full_description: Abua Awas Yojana is a State Housing Scheme of Jharkhand to build 3-room pucca houses for homeless and kutcha house families not covered under PMAY-G.
benefit: ₹2,00,000 financial assistance for 3-room pucca house
target_beneficiaries: Poor homeless & kutcha house families in Jharkhand
application_steps: Submit application at 'Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar Aapke Dwar' camps
Funds transferred to bank account in 4 installments

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
short_description: Solar pump subsidy up to 60% for farmers to set up standalone solar agriculture pumps and solarize existing grid-connected pumps.
full_description: PM-KUSUM Scheme aims to provide energy security for farmers along with increasing the share of clean energy in the agriculture sector through solar pumps and solar power plants.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefit: 60% government subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on solar pumps
application_steps: Apply through State Renewable Energy Development Agency portal

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
short_description: Skill training and financial guidance for 3 crore Self Help Group (SHG) women to earn a sustainable income of at least ₹1 Lakh per year.
full_description: Lakhpati Didi is a government initiative under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) aimed at encouraging women in rural Self Help Groups (SHGs) to start micro-enterprises.
benefit: Interest-subsidized micro-loans + skill development & market linkage
target_beneficiaries: Women members of active Rural Self Help Groups (SHGs)
application_steps: Register through local Village Organization (VO) / Community Resource Person (CRP)

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
short_description: Financial stipend support for apprenticeship training in industrial sector
full_description: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Skill Development sector.
benefit: Financial stipend support for apprenticeship training in industrial sector
target_beneficiaries: Eligible citizens under Skill Development category
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
short_description: Financial assistance and subsidy for fish farmers, aquaculture, and marine infrastructure
full_description: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Fisheries sector.
benefit: Financial assistance and subsidy for fish farmers, aquaculture, and marine infrastructure
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://pmmsy.dof.gov.in/

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
short_description: Micro-irrigation subsidy (Drip & Sprinkler) for efficient farm water management
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Farmers sector.
benefit: Micro-irrigation subsidy (Drip & Sprinkler) for efficient farm water management
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://pmksy.gov.in/

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - DAY-NRLM
short_description: Revolving fund & Community Investment Fund for rural Self Help Groups (SHGs)
full_description: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - DAY-NRLM is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Rural Development sector.
benefit: Revolving fund & Community Investment Fund for rural Self Help Groups (SHGs)
target_beneficiaries: Eligible citizens under Rural Development category
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://nrlm.gov.in/

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - DAY-NULM
short_description: Skill training, micro-enterprise loans, and shelter for urban poor
full_description: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - DAY-NULM is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Urban Development sector.
benefit: Skill training, micro-enterprise loans, and shelter for urban poor
target_beneficiaries: Eligible citizens under Urban Development category
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://nulm.gov.in/

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
short_description: Free soil testing and customized nutrient recommendation cards for farm land
full_description: Soil Health Card Scheme is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Farmers sector.
benefit: Free soil testing and customized nutrient recommendation cards for farm land
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in/

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
short_description: Concessional short-term agricultural loan at 4% interest rate for farmers and fishers
full_description: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Farmers sector.
benefit: Concessional short-term agricultural loan at 4% interest rate for farmers and fishers
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kcc

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)
short_description: Infrastructure development in minority concentrated areas including schools & hostels
full_description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Minority Welfare sector.
benefit: Infrastructure development in minority concentrated areas including schools & hostels
target_beneficiaries: Eligible citizens under Minority Welfare category
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://pmjvk.minorityaffairs.gov.in/

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Students
short_name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Students
short_description: Financial assistance for pursuing Master's & Ph.D. degrees in top foreign universities
full_description: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Students is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Students sector.
benefit: Financial assistance for pursuing Master's & Ph.D. degrees in top foreign universities
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://nosmsje.gov.in/

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
short_description: Scholarship grant to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class 9th and 10th
full_description: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Students sector.
benefit: Scholarship grant to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class 9th and 10th
application_steps: Visit official scheme portal at https://scholarships.gov.in/

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
short_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
short_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top 20th percentile Class 12th passed students
full_description: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students is an official Central Government scheme implemented by the Government of India under Students sector.
benefit: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top 20th percentile Class 12th passed students
